description_en: Creates a recording plan based on a time template
description_zh: 调用该接口，根据时间模板创建录像计划
name: CreateRecordPlan

parameters.description_en:
The name of the recording plan.

The name must be fewer than 48 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and the following special characters: hyphens (-), underscores (_), at signs (@), periods (.), and colons (:).
parameters.description_zh:
录像计划名称。

名称长度小于48个字符，可以包含英文字母、数字和特殊字符：短划线（-）、下划线（_）、at（@）、英文句号（.）、英文冒号（:）。
parameters.help_en:
The name of the recording plan.

The name must be fewer than 48 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and the following special characters: hyphens (-), underscores (_), at signs (@), periods (.), and colons (:)
parameters.help_zh:
录像计划名称。

名称长度小于48个字符，可以包含英文字母、数字和特殊字符：短划线（-）、下划线（_）、at（@）、英文句号（.）、英文冒号（:）
parameters.name: name

parameters.description_en: The ID of the time template associated with the recording plan. You can call [CreateTimeTemplate](~~107888~~) to query the ID.
parameters.description_zh: 录像计划对应的时间模板ID，可调用[CreateTimeTemplate](~~107888~~)查询。
parameters.help_en: The ID of the time template associated with the recording plan. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/107888.html to query the ID
parameters.help_zh: 录像计划对应的时间模板ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/107888.html查询
